description: BUG-05: a symlinked file is not scanned for references, so stamp cannot write through it. link.md points at sub/doc.md, whose relative target resolves to sub/t.md from its real location but to the differently-worded t.md from the repo root - so a scanned symlink would report a second pin and write a conflicting fingerprint into the same file. Exactly one pin is stamped, and it is sub/t.md's.
